description: Fork of exp321 (LUT-LM SOTA 1.5933 @ 8K). Cleaner joint-qkv variant: replace qk_joint (NAP=6, tph=256, n_out=2*d_qk=128) with a single qkv_lut (NAP=6, tph=256, n_out=2*d_qk+d_v=160). q,k come exclusively from qkv_lut. v_lut is KEPT unchanged (NAP=8, tph=256, n_out=d_v=32), and the last d_v outputs of qkv_lut are ADDED to v_lut's output (v = v_lut(x) + qkv_lut(x)[..., 2*d_qk:]). Per-layer LUT params: qkv 15.7M + v 12.6M = 28.3M (vs exp321's 25.2M). Δ=+3.1M per layer * 6 = +18.6M; total ~602M -> ~621M. Tests if sharing anchor decisions between qk and a parallel SHALLOW v-branch (NAP=6) helps, without sacrificing v_lut's NAP=8 capacity.
